lines.text: Max negotiated the Sun Ruins fee up from two hundred to two hundred and fifty crowns.
Ponticius agreed to pay 250 crowns for the artifact.
Ponticius paid half the fee in advance.
Arin signed the Sun Ruins contract.
A falling stone slab nearly crushed Luke.
Luke jumped clear of the slab and survived.
Luke broke his arm under the rubble.
Max was knocked unconscious by the collapse.
The reactor's containment field keeps flickering.
Two crew members are in the medbay with burns.
HALO sealed the hull breach on deck three.
Pell caused the reactor accident.
Maeve claimed she had never heard of the ledger.
The ledger lies under a stack of racing forms behind Maeve.
Maeve admitted she was hiding the ledger.
Max took the ledger and put it in his coat.
Brandt offered Max five hundred for a short memory.
Max slipped Brandt's envelope into his inside pocket.
Max told Mae he never took money from Brandt.
Max never took any money from Brandt.
Three candles burn along the gallery wall.
In the portrait, Lord Ashworth's hand now points at the door.
Graves moved the portrait himself.
Graves says the master's portrait has always been restless.
Max first agreed to take Luke, then changed his mind.
Luke is staying behind.
Arin wanted Luke to come along.
Luke burst into tears when he was told.
Pell got the reactor stable.
The captain ordered a mayday broadcast on all frequencies.
A nearby ship answered the mayday.
HALO refused the captain's order.
Pell sealed the hull breach on deck three.
Coolant loop two is running at about a third of its capacity.
The reactor is now stable.
Okafor ordered loop one rerouted to cover loop two.
Max aceptó el trabajo de las Ruinas del Sol.
The Sun Ruins job pays two hundred crowns.
Ponticius raised the fee to three hundred crowns.
Max signed the contract.
